scope: Content-audited revision of the retained M0/M1 evidence set: phenomenon-level evidence, empirical-target sample/effect metadata, provenance and integrity corrections, counterevidence and limitations supporting retained M0 claims, M1.E1 editorial emphasis, M1.E2 presentation-framing/congruence model discrimination, and the bounded M1.E3 headline-access candidate. The evidence set is not a systematic review or calibration dataset; r2 corrects/qualifies metadata without changing retained model equations or benchmark results.
